senses.gloss: (cmp. כָּתַת) to join; denom. כָּתֵף.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. II, 3 כתופין, ed. Bub. כתיפין, read: כפותין, v. כָּפַת.]

(denom. of כָּתֵף) to carry; to shoulder. Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵇ מְכַתְּפֵי פירות carriers of fruits (in the Sabbatical year). Y. Nidd. II, beg. 49ᵈ היתה מְכַתֶּפֶת יינות וכ׳ carried vessels with wine for libations; (Bab.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 31a:11">B. Kam. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>עמד לכַתֵּף</he> he halted for the sake of shifting the burden on his shoulder; <cite ref="Ketubot 31a">Keth. 31ᵃ</cite>, sq.; <cite ref="Shabbat 5b">Sabb. 5ᵇ</cite>.

Ib. 8ᵃ; Erub. 33ᵃ רבים מְכַתְּפִין עליו people rest and rearrange their burdens on it. [Bets. 25ᵇ ובלבר שלא יְכַתֵּף provided one allows not the chair to be carried on shoulders, v. אֲלַנְקִי; perhaps to be read: יִכָּתֵף Nif.]
